intro.title: Your Private Chauffeur from Lisbon Airport
intro.p1: After a long flight, your onward journey should be simple.
intro.p2: With Off We Go Portugal, your chauffeur monitors your flight and meets you in the arrivals area at Lisbon Airport with a personalised name sign.
intro.p3: From there, we'll assist with your luggage and escort you to your private Mercedes for a comfortable door-to-door journey to your hotel, private residence or next destination.
intro.p4: Airport arrivals include up to 60 minutes of complimentary waiting time after flight arrival, giving you time to complete the normal arrival formalities before meeting your chauffeur.
intro.imageAlt: Private chauffeur Meet and Greet Lisbon Airport

directions.title: Arrivals and Departures
directions.body: For departures, your pickup time can be coordinated according to your flight schedule and requested arrival time at the airport.

destinations.title: From Lisbon Airport to Your Next Destination
destinations.p1: Your private airport transfer doesn't have to end in Lisbon.
destinations.p2: Off We Go Portugal provides door-to-door transportation from Lisbon Airport to destinations throughout Portugal and selected destinations in Spain.

items.question: Where will my chauffeur meet me at Lisbon Airport?
items.answer: Your chauffeur will meet you in the arrivals area with a personalised name sign. Final meeting instructions will be provided with your service details.

items.question: What happens if my flight is delayed?
items.answer: We monitor your flight arrival so the service can be coordinated according to the updated flight information.

items.question: How much waiting time is included?
items.answer: Lisbon Airport arrivals include up to 60 minutes of complimentary waiting time after flight arrival.

items.question: Can you take us directly from Lisbon Airport to another city?
items.answer: Yes. We provide long-distance private transfers from Lisbon Airport to destinations throughout Portugal and selected destinations in Spain.

items.question: Can I book a transfer to Lisbon Airport for my departure flight?
items.answer: Yes. We provide both airport arrivals and departures. Your pickup can be coordinated according to your flight schedule.

items.question: Can you provide child seats?
items.answer: Yes. Child seats can be requested in advance. Please provide the child's age when booking so the appropriate seat can be arranged.

items.question: What if we have a lot of luggage?
items.answer: Please provide the number and approximate size of your bags when booking. We'll recommend the appropriate vehicle according to your passenger and luggage requirements.

items.question: Can you accommodate groups?
items.answer: Yes. Transportation can be coordinated according to the number of passengers and luggage, including larger vehicle requirements when necessary.
